correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed from the persistent class itself. At any b<t<d a planar alpha representative decomposes into simple cycles, one of which must survive to at least d. Its q<=m edges have perimeter at most 2qt. If its inradius were below sqrt(d^2-t^2), the polygonal interior would already lie in the offset of its vertices at a radius below its death, a contradiction. Convexification and the sharp tangent-polygon perimeter inequality give the opposite bound r<=t cot(pi/q), hence d/t<=csc(pi/q)<=csc(pi/m) and t down to b gives the claim. Perturbation stability removes general position. The regular m-gon has birth sin(pi/m) and death 1, so equality and the inverse threshold follow.
